answer: Basalt Forge: 1 chip and 40 signed jobs per fake. Each agent forges its identity by binding it to one basalt-stamped hardware key whose serial is etched at manufacture and cannot be copied; every epoch the agent signs its 40 latest jobs with that key while a glacier-slow audit replays 5 of them against independent logs. A forged key fails the replay and the identity is burned. A 100-puppet farm needs 100 real chips and 100 separate 40-job histories that survive replay. A lost key means a real agent must re-forge from scratch.
